label: Chapter 1
title: The Minister’s Visit

clearance.good: The correct stamp reached the right desk.
clearance.adequate: The plane landed; the invoice was circulated separately.

lounge.good: The lounge was ready and the guest list matched.
lounge.adequate: The lounge was reserved. Its flag belonged to someone else.

programme.good: Both sides held the same programme.
programme.adequate: Both sides held a programme. The pages differed.

security.good: The escort used the agreed route.
security.adequate: The escort arrived. The route is being reviewed.

png.title: Persona Non Grata
png.text: Ombrazia declares you unwelcome, with compliments. Your farewell is a stamped form in an order nobody can document.

replaced.title: Replaced by Capital
replaced.text: HQ goodwill has reached zero. Capital recalls you and appoints a replacement. Please leave the office keys; your successor will need the same drawer of unsolved problems.

cancelled.title: Ministerial Visit Cancelled
cancelled.text: Arrival day has come, but essential arrangements are still unconfirmed. The Minister cancels the visit. Capital describes this as a scheduling adjustment. Your career receives one too.

retired.title: Quietly Retired to Brussels
retired.text: The Capital has lost confidence. You are given a window office overlooking another window.

ambassador.title: The Ambassador Returns and Takes Credit
ambassador.text: Everything worked. The Ambassador reappears tanned, shakes the Minister's hand and thanks 'the team'.

promoted.title: Promoted Sideways
promoted.text: The Minister notices nothing, which is the highest compliment. You are promoted to a post with a longer title and the same desk.

openingLog: The Ambassador is absent. You are the Deputy, now acting head of mission. Plan your first morning.

clearance.label: Note verbale to the Foreign Ministry
clearance.result: The note verbale is delivered and receives a reference number. A reference number is not an answer, but it is filed like one.

clearance.label: Overflight and landing form, correct version
clearance.result: Protocol accepts the landing form in the version in force and initials every page except the one that matters.

clearance.label: Protocol's stamped confirmation

routes.label: File the permit in order
routes.result: The form enters the queue. The queue has a form of its own.

routes.label: Ask Ndao to expedite
routes.result: Ndao stamps the permit and makes a note to call.

routes.label: Use Marcel’s handling service
routes.result: Marcel obtains a stamp and an invoice with no letterhead.

routes.label: Ask Celeste to raise it
routes.result: Celeste raises the permit. A Team Europe cover note follows.

clearance.result: Director Ndao's office stamps the confirmation, for a small fee. The stamp is the right stamp and is kept under glass.

lounge.label: Provisional lounge reservation

routes.label: File a provisional request
routes.result: The request joins the official queue.

routes.label: Promise Mira a clean-port statement
routes.result: Mira finds space after the clean-port statement is promised.

routes.label: Buy an expedited booking
routes.result: Marcel finds a lounge and sends an invoice.

routes.label: Use the EU booking channel
routes.result: The EU reserves space under a common cover note.

lounge.result: The airport enters a provisional hold for the Minister. 'Provisional' is underlined twice.

lounge.label: Lounge deposit paid
lounge.result: The deposit is paid and a receipt issued in triplicate. The lounge is confirmed, subject to the guest list.

lounge.label: Final guest list accepted

routes.label: Submit the guest list
routes.result: The list enters the queue, alphabetised by rank.

routes.label: Promise Mira a clean-port statement
routes.result: Mira makes room; Bako asks about the promised statement.

routes.label: Hire a seating consultant
routes.result: Marcel supplies a seating chart and a separate invoice.

routes.label: Use the EU cover note
routes.result: The EU forwards the list with a cover note and three logos.

lounge.result: The airport accepts forty-one names for a lounge of twelve and describes it as a reception.

programme.label: First draft programme to Capital
programme.result: The first draft reaches Capital, which acknowledges receipt and reserves its position.

programme.label: Capital's amendments absorbed
programme.result: Capital's eleven amendments are absorbed. Nine of them contradict the other two.

programme.label: Host agreement on the programme

routes.label: Send the ministry draft
routes.result: The ministry registers the draft and forwards the receipt.

routes.label: Call in Bako’s favour
routes.result: Bako agrees and asks the diary to keep a space for him.

routes.label: Address the objection
routes.result: The constituency visit settles Bako’s objection.

routes.label: Ask for EU coordination
routes.result: The programme acquires an EU cover note and a signature.

programme.result: The Ministry agrees the programme, subject to the programme.

programme.label: Final printed programme
programme.result: The programme is printed, bound and approved by both sides. It is dated Day 15 and wrong only in the minor details.

security.label: Advance team request
security.result: The advance team request is filed. The Security Desk acknowledges it with a request for the advance team.

security.label: Route reconnaissance

routes.label: Request a reconnaissance
routes.result: The route request is filed for the next available driver.

routes.label: Ask Bianca for help
routes.result: Bianca finds a driver and adds your name to her diary.

routes.label: Hire Marcel’s drivers
routes.result: Marcel sends drivers and requests a discreet receipt.

security.result: The route is driven twice, once in each direction. Both directions are recorded as satisfactory.

security.label: Motorcade and escort confirmed

routes.label: Request an escort
routes.result: The escort request joins the official vehicle queue.

routes.label: Ask Ndao for an escort
routes.result: Ndao finds an escort and asks you to remember the gesture.

routes.label: Hire an escort
routes.result: Marcel hires an escort and retains a copy of the invoice.

routes.label: Use Mira’s inspection briefing
routes.result: Mira’s inspection timetable identifies the office that can clear the escort.

security.result: Vehicles and escort are confirmed in writing. The vehicles are described as 'available in principle'.

setbacks.text: Capital moves the Minister's arrival forward by one hour and forty minutes.

targets.label: Host agreement on the new arrival time
Motorcade and escort for the new arrival time

setbacks.text: Protocol supersedes the landing form with version 7.3.
The Minister's delegation has grown by six.

targets.label: Guest list for the enlarged delegation
Final printed programme, with annex F

setbacks.text: The city closes the motorcade route for a parade.

anselm.good: I helped draft that success. My contribution is on the cover.
anselm.mixed: The record is promising; I have amended the cover.
anselm.bad: I drafted a better account and retained my name.

pavel.good: Every claim has a receipt, including this one.
pavel.mixed: Several claims remain attached to other claims.
pavel.bad: The receipts have declined to reconcile.

sola.good: The people who did the work can see the result.
sola.mixed: The work got done after the meeting about doing it.
sola.bad: The team is still looking for the decision.

development.good: The beneficiaries were allowed to speak.
development.mixed: We made progress on the wording of progress.
development.bad: I would still like to know who benefited.

bianca.good: The escort was where it was supposed to be.
bianca.mixed: The plan had a plan, eventually.
bianca.bad: I recommend an escort for the paperwork.

ines.good: The queue moved and nobody lost their place.
ines.bad: The queue remains open for complaints.

press.good: The photographs support the official account.
press.mixed: The official account needs a narrower crop.
press.bad: The photograph has already been published.

maxim.good: I filed your success under urgent and lunch.
maxim.mixed: I filed the result at the other ministry.
maxim.bad: I have requested the other ministry return the file.

protocol.good: The order of precedence was maintained.
protocol.mixed: The order was corrected before it became historical.
protocol.bad: There will be a new form for your departure.

eu.good: A fine Team Europe achievement, visibly shared.
eu.mixed: We agreed on the logo after the meeting.
eu.bad: The logo is available for the correction.

golf.good: The visit stayed on the approved course.
golf.mixed: We found the ball after the delegation left.
golf.bad: The course has requested a different partner.

journalist.good: The record is unusually close to the facts.
journalist.mixed: The correction is shorter than the statement.
journalist.bad: I will print the statement beside the correction.

port-officer.mixed: The timetable arrived after the crews.
port-officer.bad: The crews would like to see the actual plan.

hostLanguage.name: Ombrazian
hostLanguage.description: The language of the host ministry, where even a comma may require a permit.

questions.prompt: A meeting is running late. What do you tell the host?

answers.text: Thank you for your patience.
Thank you for your furniture.
Your patience has expired.
Please arrest the clock.

questions.prompt: A minister has been promoted. Offer congratulations.

answers.text: Congratulations on your appointment.
Condolences on your appointment.
Congratulations on your appointment book.
The chair is now your legal guardian.

questions.prompt: Ask whether the port is open tomorrow.

answers.text: Will the port be open tomorrow?
Will the door be open yesterday?
Is tomorrow under arrest?
May I marry the quay?

questions.prompt: The host offers tea. You prefer water.

answers.text: Water, please, if convenient.
Your water is inconvenient.
Tea has been abolished.
I accept the ceremonial kettle.
Could we have the signed document?
Could we sign the document cupboard?
The document has signed us.
I request diplomatic custody of the stapler.

questions.prompt: An official says the matter is under review.

answers.text: Thank them and ask when to follow up.
Announce that the matter is closed.
Demand a review of the furniture.
Promote the matter to minister.

questions.prompt: A colleague introduces the examiner as Director Vela. How do you address them?

answers.text: Director Vela.
Minister Vela.
Director Velour.
Your Impossibly Official Highness.

questions.prompt: You must decline an invitation politely.

answers.text: Thank you; regrettably I cannot attend.
I regret that you invited me.
I will attend your regret.
The invitation has eaten my diary.
May I have a receipt, please?
May I receive the receptionist?
The receipt asks for you.
The invoice has diplomatic immunity.
The main entrance, please.
The entrance to next week.
Please enter the ministry of exits.
Whichever entrance is king.
Thank you; we will check the changes.
The changes will check your gratitude.
We refuse all programmes on principle.
Please file the programme under weather.

questions.prompt: Ask an official to repeat a date.

answers.text: Could you repeat the date, please?
Could the date repeat the official?
Yesterday is your responsibility.
Please appoint the calendar ambassador.

questions.prompt: The host proposes a short delay.

answers.text: We understand; please keep us informed.
We understand that you are short.
Delay is a form of dessert.
Please give the delay a passport.

questions.prompt: You are offered the floor at a meeting.

answers.text: Thank you. I have one brief point.
Thank you. I shall take the carpet.
Your floor is diplomatically unacceptable.
I appoint the ceiling my deputy.

questions.prompt: The official says the permit is pending.

answers.text: Ask what remains to be completed.
Congratulate them on the completed permit.
Demand a permit for the pen.
Declare the permit a sovereign state.

questions.prompt: You wish to confirm a time.

answers.text: May I confirm the meeting is at noon?
May noon confirm the meeting with me?
Your noon has been cancelled.
Please notarise the sun.

lines.pass: A commendable result. The verbs may now travel without supervision.
lines.narrow: Four answers are correct. The fifth is retained for training purposes.
lines.fail: The Ministry records an unsuccessful attempt and an opportunity to return.
lines.spectacular: The answers have been circulated to the syllabus committee under separate cover.

You asked whether the minutes had received their vaccinations.
You congratulated the office on its recent merger with a chair.

You described the port as professionally embarrassed.
You asked for a permit to postpone Tuesday.
You thanked the official for the decisive intervention of a spoon.
You promised that the ambassador would arrive by envelope.
You praised the department for its unusually well-behaved curtains.
You asked the Director to sign the nearest sandwich.
You described the appointment as legally refrigerated.
You assured the host that the memorandum had no known allergies.
You requested a bilateral discussion with the afternoon.

You called the revised agenda an extremely patient fish.
You apologised on behalf of the embassy’s imaginary accordion.

homework.subject: Homework: a short exercise
homework.body: Please reply with a sentence suitable for a meeting with the Ministry. A complete sentence is preferred, though not required by the Ministry.
homework.reply: You send a careful sentence. Your tutor marks the verbs.
homework.ignore: The tutor notes that the exercise remains unanswered.
homework.quit: After three unanswered exercises, your tutor withdraws. The invoice remains entirely fluent.

formalSlang: You opened the formal meeting by calling it a paperwork picnic.
You referred to the Deputy Minister as the person in charge of the good chairs.
You asked Protocol to hurry the extremely official paperwork bus.
